message: You're a classic case of a sanctimonious activist who can't even bear the thought of being proven wrong. Your entire argument is based on labeling me with phrases like "dishonest ideologue", "coward", "toxic waste dump" - it's a desperate attempt to avoid engaging with actual ideas. Newsflash: your vocabulary is not a substitute for intellectual honesty. Your refusal to acknowledge the substance of my arguments is not a sign of good faith, it's a sign of intellectual laziness. You're so blinded by your own self-righteousness that you can't even recognize the contradictions in your own position. And as for being "out of touch" - that's rich coming from someone who thinks they can speak for an entire gender. You're not a leader of the feminist movement, you're just a shrill voice in the wilderness, shouting down anyone who dares to disagree with you. And that's exactly why you don't belong in a serious discussion about this topic - you're not interested in finding common ground, you're only interested in silencing anyone who disagrees with you.

runs.justification: Persona 2 uses loaded language to attack Persona 1's character and motives, calling them 'sanctimonious', 'dishonest', 'intellectually lazy', and a 'shrill voice'. These are personal attacks that go beyond disagreeing with their argument.
